The '''Sons of Gamorr''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] street gang that was active on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was part of the [[Gauntlet (gang)|Gauntlet]] gang.
